10357.d: The Fight Arena is a large structure south of Ardougne.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use the Fairy ring code DJP and run south.
• Use the Ardougne lodestone, walk South through the Zoo and past the Monastery.
• Take a charter-ship to Port Khazard and walk West.
• Use the Ardougne Cloak to teleport to Ardougne Monastery and continue South East.
• Use the Yanille lodestone, walk East through the city and continue North.

10468.d: The fire altar is a runecrafting altar located in the Fire Rune Temple, which is used to craft fire runes from rune essence or pure essence with the Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players can enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A fire talisman
• An elemental talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A fire tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A fire talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a fire altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use a ring of duelling to teleport to Het's Oasis, then go north to the altar.
• Use a dungeoneering cape to teleport to the Al Kharid scorpion mine, then go south to the altar.
• Use a sand seed or mystical sand seed to teleport to the Garden of Kharid, then go south to the altar.
• Use Home Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone, then go north out of the city and north to the altar.
